reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and I don't have a magnesium product yet, so one box at the launch price is an easy test. The lab report behind the QR code makes me a bit more comfortable than a random TikTok brand.
objection: Two capsules every day is a chore, and I already have my Toplux routine. I'm not sure a TikTok brand I've never heard of is worth switching my habits for, and I'd want to check with my doctor on the dose first.
would_change_my_mind: Hearing from my doctor that 200 mg a day is the right amount for me, or finding out the lab report doesn't match the batch on the box.
